measured.lineup: the asset is one of A to D in lineup.png beside models/uplant2.mdl, models/uplant3.mdl, models/uplant1.mdl
measured.lineupTest: asked 4 times, each in another order, which of the four was not made by Valve: judges picked D, C, B, D where the asset was D, B, B, D: told apart
measured.lineupWhy:
1. D is a solid rectangular block, while A to C are thin, organic plant shapes, so its silhouette and proportions don't match the others.
2. D is a flat grey, stone-like surface with no green, while A to C are painted in layered greens with shading.
3. D has no stems, leaves or blades at all, so it has none of the plant detail that A to C show.
